image.name: faster-whisper
image.description: [Faster-whisper](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper) is a reimplementation of OpenAI's Whisper model using CTranslate2, which is a fast inference engine for Transformer models. This container provides a Wyoming protocol server for faster-whisper.

tags.desc: Releases with Nvidia GPU support (amd64 only)
Legacy releases with Nvidia GPU support for pre-Turing cards (amd64 only)

changelog.desc: Default to `auto` for model and language if not set.
Add gpu-legacy branch for pre-Turing cards.
Add arm64 support for non-GPU builds.
Build from Github releases rather than Pypi.
Bump CUDA to 12 on GPU branch.

env_vars.name: DEBUG
env_vars.desc: If set to `true`, or any other value, the container will output debug logs.

env_vars.name: LOCAL_ONLY
env_vars.desc: If set to `true`, or any other value, the container will not attempt to download models from HuggingFace and will only use locally-provided models.

env_vars.name: WHISPER_BEAM
env_vars.desc: Number of candidates to consider simultaneously during transcription.

env_vars.name: WHISPER_LANG
env_vars.desc: Two character code for the language that you will speak to the add-on.

env_vars.name: WHISPER_MODEL
env_vars.desc: Whisper model that will be used for transcription. From [here](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper/blob/master/faster_whisper/utils.py#L11-L31).

volumes.desc: Local path for Whisper config files.

image.title: Faster-whisper
image.setup_instructions:
For use with Home Assistant [Assist](https://www.home-assistant.io/voice_control/voice_remote_local_assistant/), add the Wyoming integration and supply the hostname/IP and port that Whisper is running add-on."

When using the `gpu` tag with Nvidia GPUs, make sure you set the container to use the `nvidia` runtime and that you have the [Nvidia Container Toolkit](https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvidia-container-toolkit) installed on the host and that you run the container with the correct GPU(s) exposed. See the [Nvidia Container Toolkit docs](https://docs.nvidia.com/datacenter/cloud-native/container-toolkit/latest/sample-workload.html) for more details.

For more information see the [faster-whisper docs](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper),

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  faster-whisper:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/faster-whisper:latest
    container_name: faster-whisper
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - DEBUG= #optional
      - LOCAL_ONLY= #optional
      - WHISPER_BEAM=1 #optional
      - WHISPER_LANG=auto #optional
      - WHISPER_MODEL=auto #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/faster-whisper/data:/config
    ports:
      - 10300:10300
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=faster-whisper \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e DEBUG= `#optional` \
  -e LOCAL_ONLY= `#optional` \
  -e WHISPER_BEAM=1 `#optional` \
  -e WHISPER_LANG=auto `#optional` \
  -e WHISPER_MODEL=auto `#optional` \
  -p 10300:10300 \
  -v /path/to/faster-whisper/data:/config \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/faster-whisper:latest
